identityReview: Simon Stiell of Grenada, current UNFCCC Executive Secretary, appointed August 2022 and reappointed June 2025 for a second three-year term. Former Grenadian minister and senator, engineer by training, Westminster MBA 1998. Birth left null because December 1968 in machine evidence/secondary encyclopedias lacks independently read primary confirmation; no invented day, birthplace, engineering degree or graduation year. Distinguish executive secretary, UN Secretary-General, COP presidency and Grenada premiership.
lifeStatusEvidence: UNFCCC transcript explicitly records remarks delivered at the COP31 ministerial high-level dialogue on transparency in Antalya on 17 November 2026. This is actual delivery, not an advance programme. Reused COP30 header photograph is not claimed as 2026 visual evidence.

corrections: Current UNFCCC biography confirms August 2022 appointment and June 2025 reappointment for a second three-year term after consultation through the COP Bureau. It lists engineering training at London Metropolitan University and College of North West London, Westminster MBA, around fourteen years in technology including Nokia and GEC Plessey, and government/upper-house roles. No birth date or exact engineering degree/year given. Does not justify a day-specific 2028 term endpoint, founding the employers, holding Grenada’s premiership or chairing successive COPs.

Read original UNFCCC announcement dated 15 August 2022: Secretary-General appointment endorsed by Bureau; Grenada government work from March 2013 through June 2022, climate resilience/environment portfolio for five years plus education, human resources and junior agriculture-related roles. Senate and Leader of Government Business are not a lower-house electoral mandate. Broad career span is not assigned one identical ministry title. Announcement is not proof of the exact physical first workday in Bonn.

University of Westminster’s 7 September 2022 alumni article explicitly confirms MBA graduation in 1998, engineering studies, technology experience and interim predecessor Ibrahim Thiaw. Uses academic institution as primary evidence of MBA year without inventing engineering graduation year or degree title. Its 2022 membership counts and simplified Paris temperature wording are not used as current facts.

Read secretariat mandate: founded 1992, based in Bonn since 1996; technical expertise, analysis and review of Party information, NDC registry, negotiation support and communication. Separates secretariat service from national policy and Party decisions. No claim that Stiell personally created UNFCCC, negotiated the 2015 Paris Agreement as executive secretary, or determines governments’ policies.

Read COP27 closing release dated 20 November 2022: governments decided new funding arrangements and dedicated loss-and-damage fund, with a transitional committee to recommend operationalization at COP28. Establishment decision is not the same as an already fully operating and paying fund. Other pledges and future meetings are not treated as realized disbursements or accomplishments attributable solely to Stiell.

Read COP28 release dated 13 December 2023, including first global stocktake, energy-system transition away from fossil fuels in a just/orderly/equitable manner, and Stiell’s closing appeal for implementation. Calls and pledges are not proof that fossil use ended or all emissions goals were met. Only relevant outcome sections were used, not a full legal audit of every COP28 decision.

Read COP29 release dated 24 November 2024: annual US$300 billion goal by 2035 and efforts to scale public/private finance to US$1.3 trillion per year by 2035. The broader amount is not an additional US$1.3 trillion on top of the US$300 billion or money already paid. Stiell acknowledges unmet expectations and remaining work. Institutional consensus framing is balanced with independent reporting of explicit objections; adoption does not mean all participants enthusiastically endorsed it.

Read AP report body describing adoption in early 24 November 2024 Baku proceedings, objections from Indian negotiator Chandni Raina and other developing-country representatives to the amount and procedure. Search publication metadata starts on 23 November; primary closing release fixes event date to 24 November. Only limited attributed criticism used. No suggestion that Stiell personally controls or spends the entire global-finance goal, and no original closing video inspected.

Read delivered speech transcript for 17 November 2026 ministerial transparency dialogue, Antalya COP31. Government reporting reveals progress and gaps and feeds second global stocktake. Underlying BTR synthesis statistics were not independently audited and are not repeated in profile. Header photo is labelled COP30 and is not visual evidence of a 2026 speech. Actual-delivery description supports recent activity; ongoing COP31 is not assigned a final outcome.

Read UN Egypt republication dated 16 August with original New York release dateline 15 August 2022. Explicitly names permanent predecessor Patricia Espinosa and interim Ibrahim Thiaw, who would continue until Stiell assumed duties. This resolves succession without turning the republication date into appointment day or asserting no interim period. UN Secretary-General page was blocked by JavaScript challenge; press.un.org link returned 404, so neither is claimed as read.
